## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] No new data collection, telemetry or third-party calls (or discussed first)
- [ ] Nothing asks for, logs or stores a seed phrase, key, PIN or password
- [ ] Unreviewed content (`draft` / `needs_*_review`) cannot reach a learner
- [ ] Changed the chat prompt? Included before/after evaluation notes
- [ ] Added third-party content or data? License and attribution recorded in `NOTICE`
- [ ] Content changes (Sheng / Kiswahili wording): a second speaker has reviewed
